answer: Decaying identity bonds stop bulk forgery. Each agent locks a 500 POA bond in the trust kernel; it shrinks 5% per epoch unless honest work renews it. Newcomers dock at a jetty, where bond and work record are checked. Forging 100 fakes costs 50,000 POA plus 2,500 POA per epoch to maintain, and fakes earn nothing. An honest agent pays once, earns 300 POA per epoch, and renewal costs less than income, so honesty stays cheaper than a fake fleet.
